## Requirement coverage

| Req | Description | Task(s) | Gap justification |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| R1 | Handler facts and bounded optional values are admitted independently in native adapters and source lifting: an opt-in `Option<F>` handler result for one local fieldless enum yields zero-or-one typed facts, and bounded nominal newtypes and `Option` of them keep their exact domain through source binding, emission and decoding. Each has a shared fixture with goldens that agrees with TLC and replays false claims. Errors: unsupported carriers, aliases, nested options and unsupported source forms are located compile or source refusals; out-of-range or wrong-kind values refuse at binding or decoding; old expansions and all pre-existing artifacts stay byte-identical. | fn-237-activity-timeouts-heartbeat-and.1, fn-237-activity-timeouts-heartbeat-and.2 | — |
| R2 | The activity Model carries the four optional timeouts, Heartbeat, Tick and asynchronous cancellation. Cooperative Started Cancel records pending without changing budgets; heartbeat reports pending without closing. Complete and nonretryable Fail may win; current-attempt worker acknowledgement, retryable failure (including at the cap), and selected StartToClose/Heartbeat expiry close pending cancellation as Canceled. A fresh distinct pending Cancel rejects FailedPrecondition with an exact self-loop under the explicit invalid-state policy; same-request-ID replay is unspecified. Tick decrements all live budgets and selects one expiry by ScheduleToClose > StartToClose > Heartbeat > ScheduleToStart. Selected ScheduleToClose expires TimedOut; attempt-deadline expiry while pending is Canceled; every other applicable expiry is TimedOut. Exactly the selected deadline fact is emitted, independently of terminal phase; ordinary/nonexpiring edges have none. State the exact-action fair-worker assumptions and verify eventual closure and the spanning ScheduleToClose total-tick bound natively/default and by TLC/larger Worlds. Errors: all timeouts absent disables Tick; no pending-heartbeat evidence alone implies Canceled; zero/underflow and wrong-priority/fact/boundary controls remain discriminating. | fn-237-activity-timeouts-heartbeat-and.1, fn-237-activity-timeouts-heartbeat-and.2, fn-237-activity-timeouts-heartbeat-and.3, fn-237-activity-timeouts-heartbeat-and.6 | — |
| R3 | The final compatibility World has one attempt, atomic cancellation, one-tick schedule-to-start/start-to-close budgets and no other timeouts. It passes fn-227 R4's retained-lifecycle refinement control: a stated state/action/fact projection, including the Tick-to-deadline mapping, and exact comparison against the retained old lifecycle graph. Re-run the control after every timeout/cancellation change. Errors: a changed old lifecycle edge must fail the control; old reference bytes and every old law stay independently checked. Cooperative pending exceptions never alter the atomic compatibility policy or frozen evidence. Existing retry laws remain checked over their original atomic/nonpending scope, with separate executable cooperative boundary laws. | fn-237-activity-timeouts-heartbeat-and.3 | — |
| R4 | The realization extends fn-227's transactional live World admission to the four timeout fields through an explicit per-field timeout-to-tick table and to `asynchronous_cancel` through the explicit pinned protocol binding. Worker heartbeat and acknowledgement are program rows (fn-243), judged from server history. The live run with the raw executor, then the sdk executor with identical judgments, proves a held-started server cancellation (distinct response-hold fault, preserving the prepoll fault for schedule-to-start) with actual Cancel, pending heartbeat and acknowledgement, a completion-after-cancel race, and a schedule-to-start expiry under a hold; fn-227's retry proof and existing Complete/Fail/HostRefusal/context-Cancellation controls keep passing. Errors: out-of-domain timeout values return field-named Unsupported and freeze admission; a missing or unsupported binding names `asynchronous_cancel` and refuses admission; no generic core envelope, core ABI or Start field change. The mandatory live rows above remain unchanged. Name the boundary policy and distinguish its larger offline graph from live admitted evidence: exact pending-expiry causes require actual typed/correlated evidence; otherwise that narrow scope is predeclared field-named Unsupported and documented, never reconstructed from desired actions, configured timeouts, elapsed time or terminal Canceled alone. A surprising in-scope outcome remains a finding. No refusal discharges an original mandatory row or fn-243.5 proof. | fn-237-activity-timeouts-heartbeat-and.4 | — |
| R5 | DESIGN.md records the timeout and cancellation additions: the extended activity World and state table, deadline priority and zero/reset laws, cooperative cancellation, the exact-action fair-worker assumption, the final compatibility projection, native and TLC state counts per selected World, and `make model-time` output. No error surface beyond the gate. | fn-237-activity-timeouts-heartbeat-and.5 | — |
